responsibility: Provides the main deserialization logic for LTO GIMPLE and related streamed metadata on the reader side. It contains generic bytecode-reading helpers and tag validation, reconstructs auxiliary data such as line-map file/path information and target machine-mode tables, initializes and tears down reader-wide caches, and creates data_in objects that pair file-specific state with string tables, linker resolutions, and tree-reader caches. This file is the shared LTO input streamer infrastructure beneath higher-level section fetching and above raw compressed section bytes.
